rules.sentence: Antibiotics to cover common pathogens in case of surgical site infections need to be employed early and later adjusted per reports from cultures.
Proper hand hygiene and appropriate infection prevention strategies must be followed postoperatively caring for surgical sites.

Universal standard (infection control) measures, such as handwashing with soap and water or using alcohol-based disinfectant before and after each patient visit, are vital in reducing transmission rates of MDR pathogens.
